title: centaurea scabiosa proles calcarea
intro: Centaurea scabiosa proles calcarea, commonly known as the mountain scabious, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the sunflower family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to support respiratory health, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea scabiosa proles calcarea include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and polyphenols, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
